about_the_game:
Game Genre

Action Roguelike, Horror, Text Dialogue, 2D Platformer

Game Features

  • Horror Presentation Effects

Many levels incorporate horror-style visual and audio details to create a creepy, surreal atmosphere.

  • Classic Rogue Action Mechanics

Beyond standard movement, jumping, climbing, and three-hit combos, players gain block and counterattack abilities. Blocking builds energy to trigger special skills. Defeating a boss unlocks new skills or weapons.

  • Streamlined Character Progression

Unlike traditional permanent upgrades, Soul Balance emphasizes exploration: players collect rabbit souls across maps to enhance attributes. This allows for dynamic difficulty tuning during boss battles.

  • Procedurally Assembled Maps & Soul Collection

Maps are freshly assembled each time, preserving a sense of novelty as players hunt and collect souls.

  • Challenging Boss Encounters

Numerous stage bosses await the player's challenge.

Game Background

Set in the same universe as the game Consumables. One day in the future, a biological experiment on the moon goes horribly wrong— its subject mutates uncontrollably, overtaking much of the lunar surface. Other creatures are affected, becoming highly aggressive and hostile.

A robotic rabbit returns home to find its homeland overrun. Partnering with the scientists, it embarks on a journey to save the moon. Whether the rabbit’s decision is wise or doomed remains to be seen...

  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • VR Support: Not Supported

short_description: Soul Balance is a 2D hand‑drawn game blending horror elements with action‑roguelike mechanics. Players take on the role of a self‑aware mechanical rabbit, collecting souls on a monster‑devoured planet to upgrade abilities, fight mutated former friends, and restore the world to its former state.
supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, Italian, German, Russian, Japanese, Thai, Korean
